title: The role of infant presence and other social correlates of fetal loss in wild mandrills
content:
by Alexander J. Pritchard

The survival of offspring is an important determinant of fitness. A new study in PLOS Biology examines how early conceiving female mandrills (Mandrillus sphinx) with an infant have a higher probability of fetal loss, relative to other females.
